title: Jurisdiction-local, tamper-evident evidence ingestion by an edge hash-chained log with store-and-forward
statement: Jurisdiction-local, tamper-evident evidence ingestion by an edge hash-chained log with store-and-forward
body: Select option 2 as the design direction. It is **Proposed**, not Accepted: the review computes Blocked, and a Design ADR cannot be Accepted unless its review is Approved. The chain format and the reference behaviour are captured as a candidate contract (`greenfuel.ingestion-batch/v0-candidate`) in [ingestion-contract.mjs](../../harness/contracts/ingestion-contract.mjs), used as an acceptance oracle and not as a decision on the signing mechanism.
subject: adr.0015
